verdict.stance: Overweight / Fortress Abu Dhabi Developer with AED 38.2bn Liquidity & AED 71.6bn Backlog
verdict.summary: Exceptional 9M26 momentum: revenue rose +11% YoY to AED 26.2bn (Q3 AED 9.35bn, +16.4%), Group EBITDA jumped +20% YoY to AED 9.4bn (Aldar Investment +21% to AED 2.8bn), and 9M NPAT climbed +19% to AED 7.1bn. Group liquidity stands at AED 38.2bn (AED 18.3bn cash + AED 19.9bn undrawn lines) with AED 71.6bn development backlog.

positives: Massive liquidity fortress: AED 38.2bn total liquidity (AED 18.3bn free cash + AED 19.9bn undrawn facilities).
High recurring income anchor: Aldar Investment 9M26 Adj EBITDA +21% YoY to AED 2.8bn.
AED 71.6bn development backlog provides multi-year cash collection visibility; backed by Mubadala (~25%).
negatives: Large expansion capex & landbank deployment across UAE, Egypt (SODIC), and UK (London Square).
Real estate cycle & interest-rate sensitivity if Dubai/Abu Dhabi sales velocity moderates.
Baa2 / BBB- ratings constrain spread tightening inside Abu Dhabi sovereign.
